create_LTX2AVDenoisingStage: create an LTX2AVDenoisingStage instance with transformer, scheduler, vae, and audio_vae for audio-video denoising
run_LTX2AVDenoisingStage_post_denoising_: run the _post_denoising_loop method to finalize AV requests by gathering audio latents and unpacking both streams
create_LTX2RefinementStage: create an LTX2RefinementStage instance with transformer, scheduler, distilled_sigmas, vae, and audio_vae for stage-2 refinement
run_LTX2RefinementStage_forward: run the forward method of LTX2RefinementStage to apply distilled refinement schedule on top of shared AV denoiser
reset_LTX2RefinementStage_generators: reset stage-2 random generators for LTX2RefinementStage using batch seeds and generator device settings
